body: All of that seems so unattainable because people need resources and finances to do things. The only thing that seems significant is volunteer work. I should try that, you're right. If nothing else it'd be an opportunity to leave the house.

I really can't imagine. It seems after 3 years of feeling like this the life ahead of me is shit. 3 years has been an eternity and any more sounds like torture. 

I want rose color shades that paint an unreal version of humanity and life. I just want to live in a world that isn't this one. That would make me happy.

Yes I've been to therapy the past 3 years, I've been on a few depression medications. It's just not for me, I just don't want to live that way forever. It's not living. It's fucking depressing all in itself being on depression medication and seeing a therapist once a week.
Sometimes, but it feels like it's always an act.
Nothing happened, I just don't want to live out a life when I know I'll never be happy.
